mobile.chrome.destination.inbox.note: Label under the inbox icon in the sidebar's destinations strip (five equal slots, ~52 pt each, label at 11-12 pt). One short word; the slot truncates anything longer. Opens the notifications inbox.

mobile.chrome.destination.past.note: Label under the history icon in the sidebar's destinations strip (~52 pt slot). One short word meaning past/finished sessions; opens the resumable history list.

mobile.chrome.destination.schedules.note: Label under the clock icon in the sidebar's destinations strip (~52 pt slot). One short word; opens the list of scheduled wakes and armed monitors.

mobile.chrome.destination.inbox_count.note: Accessible name of the Inbox destination when it has unread items. {count} is a positive integer; the visible badge shows only the number. No final full stop.

mobile.chrome.destinations.note: Title of the sheet that lists the sidebar destinations when the text is too large for the icon strip (opened by 'More'). Names a set of places to go, no final full stop.

mobile.chrome.new_chat.note: Accessible name of the square-pen button in the sidebar header that starts a new conversation. No final full stop.

mobile.chrome.clear_search.note: Accessible name of the small × inside the sidebar's search field; it empties the search text. Shown only while the field has text. No final full stop.

mobile.chrome.close_conversations.note: Accessible name (screen readers only, never shown) of two controls that both dismiss the conversations sidebar: the ✕ in the sidebar header and the dimmed page strip beside the open sidebar. 'Conversations' is the sidebar's list of chat sessions, not one conversation. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.chrome.composer.more.note: Build389 shared composer context strip / exclusive home presentation. Preserve {count} plural and {host} parameters where present.

mobile.chrome.composer.dismiss_keyboard.note: Build389 shared composer context strip / exclusive home presentation. Preserve {count} plural and {host} parameters where present.

mobile.chrome.composer.queued.note: Build389 shared composer context strip / exclusive home presentation. Preserve {count} plural and {host} parameters where present.

mobile.chrome.home.greeting.note: Build389 shared composer context strip / exclusive home presentation. Preserve {count} plural and {host} parameters where present.

mobile.chrome.home.connecting.note: Build389 shared composer context strip / exclusive home presentation. Preserve {count} plural and {host} parameters where present.

mobile.chrome.home.connect.note: Exclusive home recovery story in build389 polish. Draft remains local and unsent; {host} is the known computer label, not a credential.

mobile.chrome.home.sign_in.note: Exclusive home recovery story in build389 polish. Draft remains local and unsent; {host} is the known computer label, not a credential.

mobile.chrome.home.saved_draft.note: Exclusive home recovery story in build389 polish. Draft remains local and unsent; {host} is the known computer label, not a credential.

mobile.chrome.home.reconnecting.note: Exclusive home recovery story in build389 polish. Draft remains local and unsent; {host} is the known computer label, not a credential.

mobile.chrome.composer.open_queue.note: Opens the queued-messages surface from the composer context sheet. Only rendered where the screen can open that surface; never a disabled control.

mobile.chrome.drawer.open.note: Accessible menu control, shared by home and each chat. Opens the same conversations overlay without navigating.

mobile.chrome.drawer.open_count.note: Accessible menu control with the relay unread-conversation count; {count} is a number. Preserve ICU plural arms and placeholder.

mobile.chrome.drawer.agents.note: Short mode-tab label for conversations with software agents in the shared workspace drawer, contrasted with Team Bridge.

mobile.chrome.composer.row_model.note: Row label in the composer's More sheet; the model's name is shown at the other end of the same row. A noun, no colon.

mobile.chrome.composer.row_usage.note: Row label in the composer's More sheet for how much of the model's context window is used; the reading is shown at the other end of the same row. A noun, no colon.

mobile.chrome.composer.row_cost.note: Row label in the composer's More sheet for the conversation's spend; the amount is shown at the other end of the same row. A noun, no colon.

mobile.chrome.composer.row_queue.note: Row label in the composer's More sheet for messages waiting to be sent; the count is shown at the other end of the same row. A noun, no colon.

mobile.chrome.composer.row_questions.note: Row label in the composer's More sheet for the agent's questions to the user (including ones that timed out); the count is shown at the other end of the same row and tapping the row opens the questions sheet. A plural noun, no colon.

mobile.chrome.composer.folder.note: Spoken name of the composer's icon-only folder button (screen readers; never painted). {folder} is the folder's own name, a file-system path segment such as local-operator or ~, copied verbatim and never translated. {source} is a fixed selector: chosen = the reader picked this folder for the next conversation, default = it is the connected computer's own default folder, other = unknown (a running conversation). Keep the three arms' shape and the comma-separated, list-like reading of the model button (mobile.home.chip.model_chosen).

mobile.chrome.composer.folder_hint.note: Screen-reader hint on the composer's folder button where the folder can still change: the button opens a sheet listing the computer's folders. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.chrome.composer.folder_hint_fixed.note: Screen-reader hint on the composer's folder button once the conversation has started and its folder can no longer change: the button opens a read-only sheet with the full path. Describes what the button does; no final full stop.

mobile.chrome.composer.run_settings.note: Spoken name of the composer's icon-only model-and-effort button (screen readers; never painted). {model} and {effort} are two already-translated phrases, for example 'Model, Opus 5, chosen for this conversation' and 'Effort, High'. Only the joining punctuation and order are translatable: keep model first, use the list separator natural in your language.

mobile.chrome.composer.run_settings_hint.note: Screen-reader hint on the composer's model-and-effort button: it opens one sheet listing the models and the reasoning-effort levels. 'Effort' is the same term as mobile.home.picker.effort_title. Imperative, no final full stop.

mobile.chrome.composer.run_settings_titl.note: Title of the sheet that holds both the model list and the reasoning-effort levels for a conversation. Use the same words as mobile.home.picker.model_title and mobile.home.picker.effort_title. Short: it is one line on a 320 pt phone.

mobile.chrome.composer.row_folder.note: Row label in the composer's More sheet, shown only when the folder button does not fit on a narrow phone; the folder's name is shown at the other end of the same row and tapping the row opens the folder sheet. A noun, no colon.
